name: @nuxeo-satori/builder-mcp
$tagsComment: No tags, and none needed: this tool imports no project of the workspace, only Node, the MCP SDK, zod and the identity guard in scripts/beta-harness (allowed by exact path in eslint.config.mjs). It runs the package pipeline as a command, scripts/app-package.mjs, as CI does, rather than importing libs/shared/app-definition; and the write tools run an app generator of tools/satori-generators by its path, in a process of its own (src/run-generator.ts, which loads it with tsx and gives it Nx's FsTree), rather than importing that project. Nothing may import it. A dependency on a workspace project would make the module-boundary rule report it, which is the intended alarm.

test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus what the tests run as commands rather than import: the package pipeline, its validator, the demo packages it validates and writes copies of, the identity guard, config:dev's script with the defaults it serves, and the app generators the write tools run in a process of their own. And every kit's bundle, descriptor and connectors, which the pipeline compares a kit in business-apps/packages with, through release-candidate-set.mjs. And what schema-headings.spec.ts reads: every kit's model, app, English labels and metadata layouts, and document-layouts' list of the schemas the Properties panel presents. Without them an edit to any would replay a cached pass.

lint.$comment: Declared rather than inferred: @nx/eslint/plugin infers `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does not match (see tools/satori-generators/project.json).

typecheck.$comment: Nothing else type-checks this project: `spec-typecheck.mjs` reads only `apps/` and `libs/`, and Vitest strips types without checking them. The config includes the specs.
